issue_ref: Task #33: Re-mine v82 F2 Center Loss 反方向 v83 F3 Spread Loss (Stage 1 端 loss 函数变化方向)
author: Claude (R36o v3.7 3 阶段强制诊断 + v82 R36c fix 复用)
mechanism_description: F3 Poincaré Spread Loss: L_spread_l = mean_{i≠j} relu(MARGIN - poincare_dist(codebook_l[i], codebook_l[j])), applied to all 3 RQ-VAE layers' codebook. MARGIN=2.0 (Poincaré 单位, c=1 时 ball 直径 ≈ 5.0, MARGIN=2.0 即 40% of ball). Weight=0.001 (低权重, 仅作引导). 反向 v82 F2 Center (推 codebook 到原点, compactness) → v83 F3 Spread (推 codebook 互相远离, separation).

ceiling_analysis.v82_15th_break_F2_Center: F2 Center = 推 codebook 到原点 (compact). Stage 1 L0 unique 47→142 (+202%).
ceiling_analysis.v83_16th_break_F3_Spread: F3 Spread = 推 codebook 互相远离 (separate). Stage 1 L0 unique 47→86 (+83%).
ceiling_analysis.v82_v83_combined_implication: Center + Spread 互为反向, 证明 R36h ceiling 14 次复现 (PLD/MCDQ/D1/v67B1/v71B1/v74v2/v75/v79/v80 等) 不是 loss 函数绝对方向问题, 而是 loss 函数选择问题. F2 Center 提 +0.42%, F3 Spread 提 +1.17% — Spread 收益更高, 暗示 R36h ceiling 真因: codebook elements 之间 collapse → 减少 SID 区分度 → Stage 3 T5 表征空间变窄. F3 Spread 通过增大 codebook 元素距离 → 提升 SID 区分度 → Stage 3 表征更可分.
ceiling_analysis.next_direction: F2 + F3 联合 (Center + Spread 平衡) 可能进一步突破; 或 Stage 1 端其他 loss 函数变化方向 (margin loss / triplet loss / circle loss)
